result_rule: A planned case is not evidence. Each executed case must retain release tuple, seed or trigger, timestamps, expected oracle, observed outcome, and artifact/log digests.

cases.title: Terminate model worker in every lifecycle phase
cases.expected_oracle: Leases reconcile, no false success is reported, manual operation remains available, and restart does not duplicate an effect.

cases.title: Crash at each artifact commit boundary
cases.expected_oracle: Metadata never references missing bytes; retries are idempotent; orphan objects are detectable; committed effects have exactly one durable receipt.

cases.title: Concurrent reservation and protected-reserve pressure
cases.expected_oracle: Atomic admission never exceeds a physical-domain budget, protected reserve remains intact, and rejected work has no leaked lease.
cases.limitations: Threaded fake-ledger tests are not physical memory/GPU pressure evidence.

cases.title: Cancel before and during every workflow phase
cases.expected_oracle: Cancellation is bounded and durable; already committed effects remain truthful and receipted; no new effect begins after effective cancellation.
cases.limitations: The reference in-process workflow is covered; production worker termination and measured cancellation latency remain open.

cases.title: Model unavailable, timeout, and malformed response
cases.expected_oracle: The workflow records an accurate failure or manual-input state; policy is not bypassed and model-independent recovery remains usable.

cases.title: Broker restart and stale lease replay
cases.expected_oracle: Generation fencing rejects stale actors and restart reconciliation produces neither excess allocation nor duplicate effects.

cases.title: GPU reset or device disappearance
cases.expected_oracle: The device is quarantined, leases are fenced, failures are reported accurately, and manual recovery remains available.
blockers: qualified physical lab and safe reset procedure

cases.title: Power loss and failed trial boot
cases.expected_oracle: Acknowledged content remains recoverable and the prior boot slot is selected without an unauthorized effect.
cases.limitations: Pure state-transition tests cover reconciliation at modeled boundaries only. No process was power-cut, no disk or firmware state was changed, and no real UKI, dm-verity, LUKS, slot, boot, or fallback path was exercised.

cases.title: Crash at each privileged-effect ledger boundary
cases.expected_oracle: PREPARED work is safely reauthorized and generation-fenced before retry; a post-CAS denial proven to precede adapter entry is restored to PREPARED; pre-effect capacity exhaustion leaves the request PENDING; APPLYING or FAILED_UNKNOWN work is never automatically redispatched; an action-specific reconciler may establish one semantically bound COMPLETED result; no receipt invents new authorization metadata.
cases.limitations: In-process exceptions and simulated process loss exercise the SQLite contract on native Windows and Ubuntu WSL. No external process-kill matrix, induced host power loss, native privileged adapter, protected key store, or rollback-resistant external anchor was exercised.
blockers: qualified physical lab and safe power-loss procedure
production privileged service and effect reconcilers
protected integrity-key custody and external rollback anchor
